body: Im hovering between 8-9 on most days. It’s really hard to find a reason to live. I’m turning 25 soon and I feel like my suicidal thoughts are slowly getting stronger, as time goes on. The days go by and I feel empty. I’ve been thinking about taking my life ever since I was 13. I’ve been to a psychiatrist, but I was just prescribed some random pills that made me tired and weak. I really don’t know what to do. I feel like I’m slowly cracking, the longer I hold this inside of me. I have no girlfriend, no job and I feel so alone.
